facts.fact: Revises F350. In ch 20 Meera starts a half-false claim, her first two fingertips whiten, and she corrects herself, but the white stays for the full hour as the rule requires. She tells Rohan her hands cannot vouch for anything she says in that hour, says 'I want you' anyway, and he takes it unverified on her word. The colour has returned by the time they lie afterwards.
